messages:
jin: heads-up — I hit a reproducible kvcache pagewalk slowdown with longctx (seq ~12k) using paged-attn on H100 + MI250X mix. trace attached, but summary: unexpected pagewalk churn and steady mem growth.

maya: :eyes: rough numbers? which kernels triggered (tiled vs linear)?

jin: quick snippet from the perf trace: 
```
CUDA kernel: tiled_attention_v2  time=18.2ms  calls=122
ROCm kernel: pa_paged_step  time=26.1ms  calls=118
KVCache: pagewalks/sec ~ 9.8k  evictions/sec ~ 1.2k
kvcache.meta.holes >= 420 (steady increase)
```
Behavior differs by architecture: H100 shows big variance in tiled kernel latency, MI250X shows more frequent page-table coalesces and ghost entries.

ryan: are we seeing different kernel selection heuristics between the runtimes? i.e., fallbacks that change memory access patterns?

jin: yes — kernel selection logs show fallback to tiled kernel on H100 when seq>8k; on ROCm we stick to the paged path which ends up touching more sparse page-table entries. Also noticed the batching heuristics shrink batch_size at high seq which increases overall request-per-token and triggers more small allocs.

carla: telemetry from last night load test: 
- workload: longctx synthetic (12k tokens), batch 4 -> 1k requests
- kvcache.pagetable.eviction_spike: 2026-03-17T03:12Z value +420 -> +1.4k
- mem.rss.gpu delta: +1.9GB over 30m
- kv.reuse_window_misses: 18% -> 46%
so reuse drops as page fragmentation grows.

ben: sounds like two separate issues colliding: (1) kernel fallback choices changing access pattern, (2) pagetable fragmentation leading to poor coalescing on MI. PCIe/NVLink ordering differences might exacerbate MPS owner stalling.

maya: can we try a small patch: increase the pagewalk coalesce window and bias kernel selection toward the linear kernel when kvcache.hole_count > 200? quick pseudopatch below: 
```
--- a/runtime/kv_cache.cc
+++ b/runtime/kv_cache.cc
@@
- if (seq_len > TILED_THRESHOLD) select = KERNEL_TILED;
+ if (seq_len > TILED_THRESHOLD && metadata.hole_count < 200) select = KERNEL_TILED; else select = KERNEL_LINEAR;
+ kvcache.pagetable.coalesce_window = max(64, kvcache.pagetable.coalesce_window);
```
This is just to verify hypothesis, not final.

jin: applied to local branch and ran synthetic: pagewalks/sec dropped ~35%, evictions down ~22%, mem growth reduced to +300MB over 30m. promising but need cross-gpu run.

ryan: can you run the cross-arch repro on staging (h100+mi mix) and collect GPUTop + ROCm-perf traces? assign to jin. ping infra for time slot.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by jin for branch kvcache/patch-coalesce (staging) — ETA 6m.

carla: also add a regression guard in telemetry: alert when kv.reuse_window_misses > 30% or kvcache.meta.holes grows > 300 within 10m.

maya: good call. if the cross-arch run still shows MI-specific ghost entries we should instrument a lightweight per-page shadowmap (count refs, last-touch) to nail eviction ordering.

jin: will run cross-arch and post traces here. planning to collect: kernel selection log, kvcache metrics, pagetable snapshots (light), and GPU perf counters (llc, l2, dram_reads).

ryan: thanks — update in this thread when traces uploaded. assigning follow-up to jin, owner for next 48h. :thumbsup:
